subject: CAIQ: control lineage & supporting artifacts for private deployment
messages:
From: Ethan Caldwell <ethan.caldwell@caulfieldbank.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: control lineage & supporting artifacts for private deployment

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the intro last week. As part of our procurement review for a private deployment (VPC + customer-managed keying) we need a CAIQ mapping and a small bundle of evidence to validate a handful of key controls. Specifically we need:

- A completed CAIQ spreadsheet (we attached a short template).
- Control lineage diagrams for the following high-priority controls: IAM, Key Management (KMS/HSM), Network Segmentation, and Audit Logging.
- Samples of runtime telemetry (anonymized) showing access logs and KV/cache isolation for a 7-day window.
- Retention and deletion policy docs relevant to customer data in private deploys.

Can you confirm ownership and an expected ETA for these items? Target window would be: initial CAIQ + lineage diagram within 5 business days, telemetry sample within 10 business days.

I attached our CAIQ template (caulfield_caiq_initial_questionnaire.xlsx). Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that would help.

Thanks,
Ethan Caldwell
Senior InfoSec Analyst
Caulfield Bank
security@caulfieldbank.com

Attachment: caulfield_caiq_initial_questionnaire.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Caldwell <ethan.caldwell@caulfieldbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control lineage & supporting artifacts for private deployment

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear ask and the template.

High level: we can support the CAIQ mapping and provide control-lineage diagrams plus sampled telemetry. To keep this tight I propose the following split of responsibilities and timeline: 

- Day 0 (today): confirm scope and determine any excluded subcontrols (Logan)
- Day 1–3: draft CAIQ response (Kimberly + Priyom), produce control_lineage_diagram.pdf for the four controls listed (Priyom)
- Day 4–10: extract and redact telemetry samples, produce evidence package (Marissa + David)

Kimberly / Priyom — can you take primary on the mapping and lineage diagram? Marissa / David can you own telemetry extraction and the secure upload to the Drive folder below.

Ethan — I created a secure intake folder and will share once the initial package is staged: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-caulfield-caiq-intake

If the timeline above works I’ll kick off an internal task and target to send the CAIQ + diagram by EOD Thu 2027-06-17. If you prefer an earlier call I’m available Tue afternoon.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_caiq_intake_checklist.pdf (PDF checklist, 2 pages)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control lineage & supporting artifacts for private deployment

Looping in details and initial asks.

Priyom — please draft CAIQ answers for the 4 prioritized control families and produce a control lineage diagram for each (single consolidated PDF preferred). For each control please include: 

- Owner (team + contact)
- Data flows (high level: what moves where during inference & key rotation)
- Relevant artifacts (config snippets, retention policy doc, audit log sample ids)

Marissa / David — telemetry sampling notes: we need a 7-day window, not production-identifiable (redact user ids, replace with stable pseudonyms), include header fields and timestamps. Also include retention proof (log retention policy and last rotation event). If there are any compliance blockers for extracting the sample from Private deployments (customer-side keys / air-gapped), call that out immediately.

Ethan — one clarification: do you require us to produce full raw log files or just extracted rows exported to CSV with context? If CSV is OK we’ll prepare a zipped CSV and a short README describing the redaction approach.

I’ll own the CAIQ QA pass and final packaging.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks — taking this on. Short status update and tech notes: 

- Control lineage diagrams: I’ll produce a single PDF (control_lineage_diagram.pdf) that includes four swimlanes (IAM, KMS/HSM, Network Segmentation, Audit Logging). Will annotate where autoscaling and shared cache components are logically separated in private deployments.
- Telemetry extraction: Marissa / David, recommend we export the 7-day sample as CSV with columns: timestamp, request_id (pseudonym), model_id, route, actor_type (service/user), action, latency_ms, region. I’ll provide a scrub script to pseudonymize identifiers.
- Retention docs: I’ll attach the retention policy excerpt and pointer to our KMS rotation log.

Target: CAIQ + diagram EOD Thu 2027-06-17. Telemetry ZIP by Tue 2027-06-22. I’ll upload interim files to the Drive folder and add a short README for reviewers.
